blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Choose an algorithm based on input properties, particularly whether data are already sorted.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Compare running time AND auxiliary memory: linear scan O(n) time, O(1) extra; iterative binary search O(log n), O(1) extra on sorted data.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Sorting first takes time; consider that one-time cost and the number of future searches.
